templates.title: WHEELCHAIR — EQUIPMENT-SPECIFIC CHECKLIST

checks.label: Main frame, cross-bracing and seat supports
checks.guidance: Look for cracks, bends, corrosion and loose fixings.

checks.label: Rear wheels, front castors, tyres and wheel attachment security
checks.guidance: Check for punctures, tread wear, wobble and axle security.

checks.label: Wheel locks: engagement, holding function and release
checks.guidance: Lock must hold the chair on a slope with an occupant.

checks.label: Push handles and grips
Armrests, footrests and leg supports
Seat and backrest fabric, cushions and stitching
Folding and unfolding operation
Stability and manoeuvrability during normal use
Restraints, if provided
Safe movement and braking during functional test

templates.subtitle: Complete in addition to the Master Inspection & Fitness Certificate

templates.title: SCOOP STRETCHER — EQUIPMENT-SPECIFIC CHECKLIST

checks.label: Both halves inspected for cracks, bending and deformation
Head and foot-end joining mechanisms
Locking pins, catches, latches and release controls
Secure engagement and alignment of both halves
Length adjustment and locking, where applicable
Handles, handgrips and lifting points
Patient restraints and anchor points
Assembly and disassembly performed smoothly
All locks confirmed fully engaged before handling
Functional test completed as per manufacturer instructions

templates.subtitle: Complete in addition to the Master Inspection & Fitness Certificate

templates.title: FOLDABLE STRETCHER — EQUIPMENT-SPECIFIC CHECKLIST

checks.label: Poles and frame inspected for cracks, bending and corrosion
Folding hinges, joints and pivot fixings
Locking braces / spreader bars engage and hold when open
Canvas / fabric bed: tears, fraying, stitching and pole attachment
Handles and handgrips
Feet, stands and ground-contact points
Patient restraint straps, buckles and anchor points
Folding and unfolding operation
All locks confirmed fully engaged before handling
Functional test completed as per manufacturer instructions

templates.subtitle: Complete in addition to the Master Inspection & Fitness Certificate

templates.title: STRETCHER — EQUIPMENT-SPECIFIC CHECKLIST

checks.label: Frame and structure inspected for cracks, bending and deformation
Patient platform, mattress and covers
Handles, handgrips and lifting points
Wheels, castors and brakes, where fitted
Side rails / guards and their latches, where fitted
Patient restraints and anchor points
Adjustment mechanisms (backrest, height, leg section), where applicable
Stability during normal use and patient transfer
Labels, load rating and identification legible
Functional test completed as per manufacturer instructions
